**Finding: Compliant** (MINCOMMIT — no redline)

The Agreement contains no take-or-pay exposure for Sanofi:

- **No commitment mechanics exist.** Searches for "minimum", "shortfall", and purchase-commitment phrasing return no applicable provisions anywhere in the document.
- **Forecasts are expressly non-binding.** The only volume-related mechanics are Commercialization Plan inputs at §8.2 — "non-binding sales and marketing forecasts" and "non-binding net sales projections" (p0370, p0371, p0373).
- **Supply is unquantified.** §7.3 (p0360) only requires the Parties to "negotiate in good faith to enter into a supply agreement... on commercially reasonable terms," with no committed volumes or shortfall payment.
- **Sanofi retains control.** §8.1 and §8.3 give Sanofi sole right over order processing, invoicing, pricing and distribution (p0363, p0375), so there are no volume caps on our side either.

This sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback. Diligence/Commercially Reasonable Efforts obligations are a separate commercial term handled under another rule and were not double-flagged here.
